text.tspan: Treated Water, Roasted Cumin Extract (Jeera), Fresh Lemon Juice (4%),
Raw Sugar, Himalayan Black Salt (Kala Namak), Rock Salt (Sendha Namak),
Potassium Citrate, Black Pepper Extract, Mint Oil, Acidity Regulator (INS 330),
Antioxidant (INS 300). NO ARTIFICIAL COLOURS OR PRESERVATIVES.
Store in a cool dry place. Keep chilled before drinking for peak flavour.
Roasted jeera spice particles may settle naturally — shake well.

g.text: Crush bottle after use • Clean Amdavad initiative
Roasted cumin, kala namak & digestive electrolytes
Incl. of all taxes • For sale in India only
